name: Hanayui Kimono
description: Hanayui Kimono — a WooCommerce store theme for a kimono rental and dressing shop in an old town, laid out as a hanging scroll you read from top to bottom. A formal white top header carries the shop name in the centre, the Book a fitting button, and the main menu centred on a second row with the account and the cart. Enji crimson (#B94047) is the main colour: the hero panel, the scroll spine, the collage band, every page head and the footer strip are crimson fields on plum-washi paper. The hero is a full-bleed woodblock illustration of a stone lane at dusk with a crimson panel standing on it (a vertical line in Chinese and Japanese); a cut-out kimono on its stand (transparent WebP) breaks over the panel and the hero's bottom edge. The day hangs on a crimson spine in five scenes, and a collage of pasted woodblock prints sits on a crimson band with a cut-out umbrella breaking out of it. Every picture is a woodblock-print illustration. Shippori Mincho for display, Figtree for reading. Sample content and products in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical lines only in Chinese and Japanese. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b3-29 (tategaki-vertical-scroll, full-bleed-illustration hero, centered nav, collage, woodblock, enji #B94047, Shippori Mincho + Figtree, kimono rental & dressing in fashion-beauty). A formal white top header: the shop name centred on the first row with the Book a fitting button on the right, the main menu centred on a second row between hairlines with the account and the cart; below 782 px the menu opens as a crimson overlay. Tategaki vertical scroll: the home page reads top to bottom like a hanging scroll; the day hangs on a crimson spine in five numbered scenes, and in Chinese and Japanese the hero, the scroll head and the page heads carry vertical lines (English, French and German stay horizontal). Full-bleed illustration hero: a woodblock print of an old-town lane at dusk across the whole width with a crimson panel standing on it. Collage: four woodblock prints pasted at angles with white margins on a crimson band. Break-frame: the cut-out kimono on its stand (transparent WebP) breaks over the crimson hero panel's edge and the hero's bottom edge into the shop board; the cut-out crimson umbrella breaks out of the pasted collage and over the top edge of the crimson collage band; the umbrella also breaks over the bottom edge of every page head. Every picture is a woodblock-print raster illustration generated with Grok Build. Sample content and products in en, zh-TW, ja, fr and de. Contrast: white #FFFFFF on enji #B94047 5.4:1 (hero panel, page heads, collage band, footer strip and the scroll numbers: body text and titles); paper #FBF3F0 on enji 4.9:1; deep enji #8C2A31 on paper 7.7:1 (chips on crimson, links, prices, labels) and on white 8.4:1 (white on deep 8.4:1 buttons); ink #2A1517 on paper 15.8:1, on white 17.2:1 and on mist #F4E4E0 14.0:1; plum grey #634B4D on paper 7.3:1 and on white 7.9:1 (secondary text); indigo #253458 on paper 11.2:1 (small marks; white on indigo 12.3:1); pale blush #F6D9D6 on ink 13.0:1 and white on ink 17.2:1 (footer); ink on enji only 3.2:1, never used for text.

summary.zh-TW: 臙脂色的和服租借與著裝店：版面像一幅直式捲軸，主視覺是滿版木刻版畫老街，去背和服與紙傘破框而出；含五種語言樣本。
summary.en: An enji-crimson kimono rental store read like a hanging scroll, with a full-bleed woodblock lane and cut-out kimono breaking out.
summary.ja: 臙脂色の着物レンタルと着付けのお店。掛け軸のように縦に読む構成、全面の木版画の路地、枠を破る切り抜きの着物と番傘。五か国語のサンプル付き。
summary.fr: Une boutique de location de kimonos cramoisie, lue comme un rouleau, avec une ruelle en estampe pleine page et un kimono détouré.
summary.de: Ein karminroter Kimonoverleih wie eine Hängerolle: vollflächige Holzschnitt-Gasse und ein freigestellter Kimono, der ausbricht.
